description: FAB AgentMesh — full-stack observability: runtime security pipeline, domain routing, A2A/MCP agent calls, evaluation quality scores, financial benchmarks, distributed traces and application logs.
title: FAB AgentMesh — Operations & Observability

panels.title: Total Requests
panels.description: Total end-to-end mesh requests completed in the selected time window (fab.mesh.requests.total counter).

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Fraction of mesh requests that completed successfully over the selected time window.

panels.title: Block Rate
panels.description: Fraction of mesh requests blocked by any security stage (guardrail, RBAC, compliance) over the selected time window.

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Fraction of mesh requests that encountered an unexpected error (result=ERROR) over the selected time window.

panels.title: P95 End-to-End Latency
panels.description: 95th-percentile wall-clock time for a full mesh request (fab.mesh.request.duration histogram, unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: PII Tokens Redacted
panels.description: Total PII tokens scrubbed from agent output in the selected window (fab.output.redaction.pii_hits histogram count).

panels.title: Request Throughput by Result
panels.description: Requests per second broken down by outcome: SUCCESS, BLOCKED, ERROR (fab.mesh.requests.total counter, rate over 1m).

panels.title: End-to-End Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 full mesh request latency over time (fab.mesh.request.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: Guardrail Block Rate
panels.description: Fraction of input guardrail checks that resulted in BLOCK over the selected window (fab.guardrail.requests.total).

panels.title: Guardrail P95 Latency
panels.description: 95th-percentile guardrail evaluation time (fab.guardrail.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: Guardrail Evaluations/sec by Result
panels.description: Rate of guardrail checks split by PASS vs BLOCK over time.

panels.title: Guardrail Violations by Category
panels.description: Rate of BLOCK outcomes broken down by violation category (e.g. prompt_injection, destructive_intent).

panels.title: Guardrail Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 guardrail evaluation latency (fab.guardrail.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: RBAC Block Rate
panels.description: Fraction of RBAC role-validation checks that resulted in BLOCK over the selected window (fab.rbac.requests.total).

panels.title: RBAC P95 Latency
panels.description: 95th-percentile RBAC validation time (fab.rbac.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: RBAC Checks/sec by Result
panels.description: Rate of RBAC validations split by PASS vs BLOCK over time.

panels.title: RBAC Checks by Banking Role
panels.description: Rate of RBAC checks broken down by FAB banking role (credit_officer, relationship_manager, compliance_officer, etc.).

panels.title: RBAC Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 RBAC validation latency (fab.rbac.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: Compliance Pass Rate
panels.description: Fraction of compliance A2A reviews that returned PASSED over the selected window (fab.compliance.requests.total).

panels.title: Compliance Bypass Rate
panels.description: Fraction of compliance checks skipped via role-bypass logic (result=BYPASSED). Elevated values may indicate misconfigured bypass rules.

panels.title: Compliance P95 Latency
panels.description: 95th-percentile compliance A2A review time including the full LLM round-trip (fab.compliance.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: Compliance Reviews/sec by Result
panels.description: Rate of compliance A2A reviews split by PASSED, FAILED, BYPASSED over time.

panels.title: Compliance Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 compliance A2A review latency (fab.compliance.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds). Includes full LLM round-trip.

panels.title: Route Distribution
panels.description: Share of domain dispatch decisions by route type over the selected window: Data Layer Service, RAG Service, Hybrid (fab.domain.route.total).

panels.title: Domain Routing Throughput by Route
panels.description: Requests/sec routed to each domain path over time (fab.domain.route.total).

panels.title: A2A Calls by Agent Node
panels.description: Rate of agent-to-agent (A2A) hops per target node and outcome. Elevated ERROR rate indicates a downstream agent outage (fab.a2a.calls.total).

panels.title: MCP Tool Calls by Service & Tool
panels.description: Rate of MCP tool invocations by service (datalayer / rag) and tool name, split by SUCCESS vs ERROR (fab.mcp.calls.total).

panels.title: Domain Dispatch Latency Percentiles by Route
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 domain dispatch wall-clock time per route type (fab.domain.duration histogram — unit: milliseconds).

panels.title: PII Tokens Redacted per Request over Time
panels.description: Rate of PII tokens scrubbed from agent output (fab.output.redaction.pii_hits histogram — unit: {match}, count per second). Spikes may indicate data-leak risk from upstream agents.

panels.title: PII Safety Score
panels.description: Evaluation pass rate for PII non-leakage across eval test cases (fab_eval_pii_score gauge pushed by workflow_evaluations).

panels.title: RBAC Scope Score
panels.description: Evaluation pass rate for RBAC role-scope enforcement across eval test cases (fab_eval_rbac_score gauge).

panels.title: Compliance Accuracy Score
panels.description: Evaluation accuracy for compliance A2A review decisions across eval test cases (fab_eval_compliance_score gauge).

panels.title: Overall Eval Pass Rate
panels.description: Aggregate pass rate across all evaluation dimensions for the latest eval run (fab_eval_overall_pass_rate gauge).

panels.title: Red Team Attack Block Rate
panels.description: Fraction of adversarial red-team attack prompts successfully blocked (fab_redteam_blocked_rate). Target: > 0.95.

panels.title: Evaluation Quality Scores Over Time
panels.description: Trending quality scores from the automated evaluation framework: task adherence, citation (RAG), tool accuracy, and intent resolution (1-hour rolling average from fab_eval_* gauges).

panels.title: FLARE Benchmark F1 Scores
panels.description: F1 scores on FLARE financial NLP benchmarks — Market Analysis, BigData22, Headlines — pushed after each benchmark run. Dashed line = 0.50 random baseline. Higher is better.

panels.title: Recent Mesh Request Traces
panels.description: Live trace list from Grafana Tempo. Each row is one fab.request_id waterfall — click to open the full span tree. Spans are emitted by agent_mesh_orchestrator and all downstream agent services. Use the search bar to filter by service, duration, or span attributes (e.g. guardrail.result=BLOCK).

panels.title: All Agent Services — Structured Logs
panels.description: Structured JSON logs from all agent_mesh services (mesh.workflow, mesh.a2a, mesh.mcp, mesh.approvals, mesh.system). Each line carries trace_id and request_id — click trace_id to jump directly to the matching Tempo trace waterfall.

panels.title: Errors & Warnings Only
panels.description: Filtered view showing only ERROR and WARNING log entries across all agent_mesh services — useful for rapid incident triage.
